info.text:
Gold always protects you? It once took 28 years to break even.

Gold hit $850 an ounce in January 1980 and didn't beat that price until January 2008.
Example: $850 in 1980 needed to become about $2,300 by 2008 to keep up with inflation. Gold was $865, about 62% of the buying power gone.
After inflation, gold didn't top its 1980 peak until 2025.
In late September 2026, gold hit a seven-week low; on Sept 28, spot gold was about $4,156, roughly 26% below its January 2026 record near $5,590.

Sources: LBMA gold fixing history, BLS CPI-U, Bloomberg (Sept 2025), Reuters and CNBC (Sept 28, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
